summary: Iter 27 — final acceptance of the 4 new Brand Equity features (SIMULATED DEMO + reliability, Score History Chart, Segment Significance, Survey Reminder/Resume) + the owner nudge card, plus regression verification of the iter24 conjoint public-route HIGH bug. Backend: 14/14 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_brand_equity_iter27_final.py PASS covering score-history (wave/month/week + non-owner 403), segment-significance (age SIG on identity+loyalty w/ pairwise Holm, gender ns, small-study not-testable + 403), drafts-summary (>=15 unfinished on demo + 403), full public draft lifecycle (create → get → update → delete + 404 after delete), draft-deleted-on-submit, and Conjoint public /results + /statistical-analysis (all 4 methods) reachable without a token. Existing conjoint regression suite test_conjoint_audit_2026_08.py + test_conjoint_stats_correctness.py 43/43 still PASS (no drift). Frontend: on /brand-equity/studies/demo-sim-chathai-001 be-simulated-badge, be-reliability-card (α: quality 0.89 · 4 items · n=164, identity 0.93 · 11 items · n=126, loyalty 0.72 · 2 items · n=183, awareness correctly refuses α with 'มีข้อคำถามมาตรวัดน้อยกว่า 2 ข้อ'), be-score-history (wave default with 2 wave points 53 → 60, month + week re-fetch and render, legend toggle for quality drops+restores its trendline series), be-segment-significance (age → identity SIG, loyalty SIG, awareness/quality ns; Alexander-Govern Welch ANOVA with pairwise rows including Holm-adjusted p; gender ns as expected; 4 age group means with n visible), be-unfinished-card showing count=27 + be-unfinished-copy button, be-sample-adequacy / be-glossary-card / be-dashboard-weights all render, zero console errors. Respondent resume-link flow verified end-to-end on /brand-equity/respond/demosimchathai: be-autosave-note + be-copy-resume-link appear after answering; draft id in localStorage key be_draft_id_demosimchathai; opening /brand-equity/respond/demosimchathai?draft=<uuid> in a fresh context (localStorage.clear + cookies cleared) restores the answers from the SERVER and shows a Thai success toast ('กู้คำตอบที่ทำไว้ 1 ข้อกลับมาแล้ว'). Iter-24 HIGH bug (Compare tab inert on public route) is FIXED: opened /conjoint/results/6099ac5b-... anonymously → tab-compare-methods populates compare-verdict ('ใช้ Multinomial Logit — ได้ค่า BIC ต่ำสุด และนำวิธีถัดไป (HB) อยู่ 3.2 จุด') + compare-fit-table + BIC column + integrity warning, zero console errors.

issues: The BES trendline series uses data-testid="be-trendline-series-overall" (series key = 'overall' in be-components.jsx L262), NOT 'be-trendline-series-bes' as the review request expected. The line renders correctly (solid black, thicker stroke, value labels 53 / 60), so this is purely a naming inconsistency between spec and code. Consider renaming series.key from 'overall' → 'bes' (or aliasing the testid to 'be-trendline-series-bes') so external test automation matches the spec vocabulary. LOW.

verified_acceptance_criteria: GET /segment-significance?field=age on demo-sim-chathai-001: testable=true, identity + loyalty significant, pairwise rows carry Holm-adjusted p, Alexander-Govern Welch ANOVA name; gender field → all four dimensions ns.
Small-study segment-significance returns testable=false with a reason (verified on TEST_UIBrand 0a0a1f3b, n=12) — no invented p-value.
GET /drafts-summary returns unfinished>=15 on demo (measured 27) and 403 for non-owner.
POST/GET/DELETE public/{token}/draft full lifecycle works; second POST with the same draft_id updates in place (upsert); GET after DELETE → 404.
POST public/{token}/respond with draft_id deletes the referenced draft (verified via subsequent GET → 404).

Conjoint public route: /api/conjoint/studies/{id}/results AND /statistical-analysis?method=mnl|mixed_logit|hierarchical_bayes|linear_regression all return 200 without auth — iter24 HIGH bug fix confirmed at API layer.

Frontend dashboard demo-sim-chathai-001: be-simulated-badge, be-reliability-card + per-dim be-reliability-{awareness,quality,identity,loyalty} all present; alpha numbers match spec (0.89 / 0.93 / 0.72), n>100 for quality (164) and loyalty (183); awareness correctly shown as unmeasurable.

be-score-history default = wave (2 points Wave 1 n=89, Wave 2 n=94); switching to be-history-gran-month and be-history-gran-week re-fetches; legend toggle be-history-legend-quality drops be-trendline-series-quality (1→0) and re-adds it (0→1).

be-segment-significance: age/gender/occupation field buttons all present; age verdicts render 'SIG' badges for identity + loyalty and 'ns' for awareness + quality; each row shows group means with n, test statistic, Holm-adjusted p, and Thai interpretation sentence.
be-unfinished-card renders be-unfinished-count=27 + working be-unfinished-copy button.

Respondent resume-link: be-autosave-note visible, be-copy-resume-link appears after debounced save; localStorage be_draft_id_demosimchathai holds the draft uuid; opening ?draft=<uuid> in a fresh cookie/storage-cleared context restores answers via the server and shows the Thai restore toast.

Conjoint public route (LOGGED OUT) /conjoint/results/6099ac5b-...: conjoint-plain-summary + conjoint-sample-adequacy mount, tab-compare-methods renders compare-verdict + compare-fit-table with a BIC-based verdict ('ใช้ Multinomial Logit — ได้ค่า BIC ต่ำสุด และนำ HB อยู่ 3.2 จุด'), zero console errors — iter24 HIGH bug fixed.
